tasks.title: Containerized DB bootstrap & migration workflow (dev + prod)
tasks.summary: MySQL 8 as the `db` compose service (named volume, healthcheck, utf8mb4) and a DB lifecycle that works in BOTH the dev and the slim prod image. Dev: `docker compose run --rm api npm run db:setup` + idempotent auto-migrate on boot. Prod: a ts-node-free path (compiled JS data-source + migration:run/seed scripts) runnable in the slim runtime, wired as a one-shot init service that api depends_on with condition service_completed_successfully. Also provision a real Owner on first boot (seed/claim a configurable owner Discord id — the dev-only owner seed is not valid for prod) and drop the create-database.ts XAMPP localhost/root defaults. Replaces the host-MySQL, ts-node-only db:setup assumption end-to-end.

testPlan.desc: dev: `docker compose run --rm api npm run db:setup` creates+migrates+seeds the MySQL 8 container idempotently (a re-run is a no-op)
prod: the slim image runs migrate+seed with NO ts-node (compiled JS) via the init service, then api starts
a fresh prod deploy has a legitimate Owner (real Discord id), not just the dev owner seed
